args.query: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(*) AS failures, MAX(p.created_at) AS latest FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON c.id = p.customer_id WHERE p.status = 'failed' AND p.created_at >= '2026-03-01' AND p.created_at < '2026-04-01' GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3 ORDER BY c.id
SELECT customer_id, title, status FROM tickets WHERE title LIKE 'Repeated payment failures:%'
SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id, id FROM payments WHERE status = 'failed' AND customer_id IN (1, 5) ORDER BY customer_id, created_at DESC
